summary: The patch adds the missing staging command for capture-build-info.json before the first jq call and names the production output directory as the authoritative metadata source. The digest, size, metadata write, and atomic rename steps are unchanged, so the documented strict validation path is preserved.

docs/downloads.md lines 48-50 state that the production-output capture-build-info.json for the exact staged ZIP is authoritative and that values must not be retyped
The label for the staged ZIP filename is read from the copied metadata, so an operator with the build output and the ZIP needs no retyped values
